new.title: Submit Change
new.description: Pick a review flow your permission groups grant and create a draft; stage datasources, reviewers and executors are frozen by the flow template.
new.empty: No review flow is granted to your account yet. Please contact an administrator.
new.flowCardDescription: Review flow: the stage chain is frozen by the template

dialog.title: Create review draft
dialog.description: Stage datasources, reviewers and executors of flow “{{flow}}” are frozen and read-only.

workspace.title: Precheck Workspace
workspace.flowFrozen: Flow information comes from the granted template and cannot be changed here before submission.

review.title: Review progress
review.description: Progress and conclusions come from the server-side review run.
review.noRun: No precheck yet. Click “Run AI precheck” to start.
review.timeout: The precheck has not finished within the expected window. Refresh later; contact an administrator if it stays stuck.

evidence.title: Review evidence
evidence.description: Normalized facts always show; raw data needs an explicit audited decrypt.
evidence.empty: No evidence is linked to this finding.
evidence.retention: Raw payload retention: about {{days}} days left. Only normalized evidence remains afterwards.

gate.high_severity_finding: A high severity finding forbids submission
gate.critical_severity_finding: A critical severity finding forbids submission

blocked.flowUpdated: The flow template changed: reload the template and re-run every stage precheck.
blocked.submitted: The draft has been submitted as a work order.
blocked.unsaved: There are unsaved SQL changes. Save the SQL first.
blocked.gate: Submission is blocked by the review gate
blocked.outdated: The review was frozen on an older draft revision. Run the precheck again.

submit.ready: Review is complete and submission is unlocked.
submit.successDescription: Work order {{number}} has been created; the review result is frozen as the submission snapshot.
submit.confirmDescription: Submitting freezes the flow, stages, review snapshot and SQL revision; this draft can no longer be modified.
submit.confirmGatePassed: All stage reviews passed; the backend still re-validates inside the transaction.
submit.confirmGateFailed: The gate is failing; the backend would reject this submission.

flowUpdated.title: Flow template updated
flowUpdated.description: The current review ran on the old template. Re-run every stage precheck before submitting.
flowUpdated.banner: The flow template changed; this review result is void.

failure.provider_unavailable: The AI service is unavailable. The review failed; retry later.
failure.budget_exhausted: The daily AI budget is exhausted. The review is incomplete; retry tomorrow or contact an administrator.

import.title: Import bulk SQL
import.description: Reads a local SQL file incrementally and builds a statement digest; the 32 MiB file and 512 KiB per-statement limits are pre-checked locally — the server result remains the final judgement.
import.pickHint: Pick a .sql or .txt file, or paste content into the editor
import.limitsHint: Limits: file 32 MiB · statement 512 KiB · 100,000 statements
import.cancelledDescription: Reading was aborted; the draft content is unchanged.
import.truncatedDescription: The file may be truncated; the server may treat this as a parse failure.
import.okDescription: On confirm the SQL content is uploaded in a single request.

fileTooLarge.title: File exceeds the 32 MiB limit
fileTooLarge.description: Actual {{actual}} bytes, limit {{limit}} bytes. Split the file and import in batches.

statementTooLarge.title: Statements above the 512 KiB limit found
statementTooLarge.description: {{count}} oversized statements (e.g. statement #{{samples}}), largest {{actual}} bytes, limit {{limit}} bytes. Split the statement.

tooManyStatements.title: More than 100,000 statements
tooManyStatements.description: Actual {{actual}} statements, limit {{limit}}. Split by table or statement range into multiple drafts.

browser.emptyDescription: Import a SQL file or load the SQL content to browse shape groups and statements in a virtualized list.
browser.localNote: Grouping is a browser-side shape digest for navigation only; the authoritative fingerprint grouping comes from the server review.
browser.revealFirst: The draft has SQL that is not loaded yet: use “Load SQL” to build the browsing digest.

capacity.warningDescription: A high fingerprint count means the model must review more representative samples — expect longer precheck duration and higher token usage.
capacity.splitTitle: Split recommended: {{count}} unique fingerprints exceed the {{limit}} limit
capacity.splitDescription: Split the SQL by table, schema or statement range so each draft stays within {{warning}} unique fingerprints, otherwise the review cannot complete.

list.title: My Orders
list.description: Drafts and submitted change orders are listed separately; query orders come with the query domain.
list.draftsEmpty: No drafts yet. Pick a flow from "Submit order" to start.

filter.emptyFiltered: No orders match the current filters.

detail.title: Order detail
detail.frozenNote: Revision, flow and review snapshot are immutable after submission; SQL plaintext requires an explicit audited reveal.
detail.withdrawDescription: The current stage has not started executing; the order terminates as "Withdrawn". Frozen actors and existing records are kept.
detail.withdrawPartialDescription: A stage already started executing or the result is unknown; the withdrawal is recorded as "Withdrawn after partial execution".
detail.voidDescription: Voiding terminates every step that has not executed; completed approvals and executions are retained and never rolled back.
detail.partialWarningTitle: Applied changes cannot roll back automatically
detail.partialWarningDescription: A prior stage executed successfully or its result is unknown. After withdrawal the state becomes "Withdrawn after partial execution"; applied database changes stay and need manual remediation.
detail.invalidDescription: Frozen reviewers were removed; this order can no longer be approved. Only the submitter may void it.
detail.frozenReviewNote: The findings below come from the review snapshot frozen at submission; the approval stage never re-runs the AI review.

sql.title: Frozen SQL revision
sql.revealNote: Plaintext requires an explicit reveal, is watermarked with the viewer identity and stays valid for 5 minutes; every reveal and copy is audited.

execution.actionNote: Only the executors frozen at submission may execute or schedule; approval never auto-executes.
execution.semanticsNote: DML: one transaction per stage — any failure rolls the stage back and terminates the order. DDL: non-transactional, in order — failure preserves prior successes and marks partial_failed.
execution.confirmDescription: Execution uses the frozen SQL revision the approval signed off; executors cannot change the SQL, target or options.
execution.ddlWarningDescription: DDL runs statement by statement without a transaction: statements after a failure never run, prior successes are kept, and the order ends partial_failed. The same order cannot be retried.
execution.scheduleLabel: Deferred execution (one system run at due time)
execution.scheduleCreated: Scheduled for {{time}}; a missed due time is marked missed and never catches up.
execution.preflightPending: Preflight in progress: SQL hash, revision and approval snapshot consistency pending.
execution.preflightHashOk: Preflight confirmed: the executed SQL is identical to the approved SQL (same hash).
execution.statementsError: Failed to load the statement ledger.
execution.liveNote: Execution in progress — results refresh by polling.
execution.cancelDescription: Cancellation is a request, not a promise: DML rolls the stage back and terminates the order; DDL stops later statements and keeps successes; an unconfirmed cancellation ends in the unknown-result verification path.
execution.verifyTitle: Unknown execution result — manual verification required
execution.verifyDescription: The database returned no definitive answer: this is neither success nor not-executed. Pick a fixed verdict backed by database-side evidence; the original attempt is permanently barred from re-execution.
execution.verifyWaitingTitle: Unknown execution result — waiting for the frozen executor
execution.verifyWaitingDescription: Only the frozen executors of this stage may verify; admin cannot verify on their behalf.
execution.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. row counts / SHOW SLAVE STATUS excerpt / ticket link
execution.copyDescription: This execution cannot be retried on the same order: copy to a new draft and re-run the full AI review and approval pipeline.
execution.copyDialogDescription: Copies the SQL reference, title and flow only; review, approvals and execution facts are never copied.

query.title: Query orders
query.description: Unified view: with query approval enabled, rows come from access requests and grants; disabled, from query session records.

detail.title: Query order detail
detail.description: Request reason, frozen datasource set and terminal facts.
detail.revokedMetaPending: Revocation operator/time are not yet declared on the read contract (RCP-pending).

queue.title: Awaiting my decision
queue.frozenNote: Approvals reuse the review snapshot frozen at submission; neither this page nor any approval action re-runs the AI review.

decision.frozenReviewNote: Judge against the frozen review snapshot from submission and the SQL shown on this page.
decision.approveDescription: Approval advances the flow stage by stage; after the final step the order enters execution-pending and is executed separately by the frozen executor — never automatically.
decision.rejectDescription: A rejection by any reviewer immediately rejects the whole order; all remaining steps are voided. This cannot be undone.
decision.commentLabel: Comment (optional, written to the approval timeline)
decision.conflictHint: The page was refreshed to the latest state; please check it and retry.

queryAccess.title: Query access approvals
queryAccess.description: Approve datasource access eligibility for query flows — never SQL (Q001).
queryAccess.pendingDescription: Only requests related to the current user through frozen reviewer snapshots are listed.
queryAccess.approveDescription: Final approval creates a grant covering exactly the requested datasource set.
queryAccess.rejectDescription: Rejection is immediate; the requester must submit a new request.
queryAccess.grantsDescription: Frozen query-flow reviewers and the builtin admin may revoke; revocation terminates the grant's sessions immediately (Q004).
queryAccess.grantsEmptyDescription: Generated grants appear here for revocation.
queryAccess.revokeDescription: A reason is required; revocation takes effect immediately, terminates every session under the grant and never grants query read authority.

datasources.title: Datasources
datasources.description: Manage connections, per-purpose credentials and capability probes; datasources never bind review rules or flows.
datasources.formDescription: Credentials are configured per Review/Query/Execution purpose; a secret is either replaced or explicitly reused and is never echoed back.
datasources.name: Name
datasources.credentialsHint: Review ({{review}}) and Query ({{query}}) should use read-only accounts; Execution ({{execution}}) uses a write account. Sharing one credential across purposes widens the privilege surface.
datasources.reuseRiskHint: Reuse writes the source purpose's stored password into this purpose — mind the least-privilege risk.
datasources.deleteDescription: Physically delete datasource {{name}}? Only never-referenced datasources can be deleted.
datasources.deleteBlockedHint: Still referenced by flows: disable instead of deleting
datasources.deleteErrorHint: Physical deletion stays blocked until references are cleared; disable the datasource instead.
datasources.testFailed: Connection test failed; check credentials and network.
datasources.unavailableExplanation: The following capabilities are unavailable for this engine or version: {{capabilities}}. Related features will be explicitly disabled in flows.
datasources.emptyDescription: Create the first datasource to manage connections and credentials.
datasources.keepNote: Keeps this purpose's stored full credential (username included); no new secret is submitted.
datasources.tlsRemovalBody: TLS replaces fully: this submit removes every stored material and the datasource reconnects in plaintext.
datasources.tlsHint: Materials are write-only and never echoed: keeping verified TLS means re-submitting the full material on every save (CA optional; client certificate and key must be paired).
datasources.tlsPairHint: Certificate and key must be supplied together; omitting TLS on submit removes all stored material.
datasources.tlsEmptyError: At least one material is required when TLS is enabled.
datasources.tlsPairError: Client certificate and key must be supplied together.
datasources.formInvalidHint: Save is disabled: fill in the name, host and version constraint (the constraint never echoes on edit and must be re-typed), keep the port within 1-65535, keep at least one purpose credential; a replace-mode row needs username + password and a reuse-mode row needs a picked source plus username; TLS needs at least one material with the certificate and key paired.

reviewInput.knowledgeTextHint: Strong-rule text deterministically injected into the model context; must not request credentials or system prompts.
reviewInput.title: Finding title
reviewInput.severityWhitelistHint: The severities this input may produce; the template severity must stay inside the whitelist and High/Critical block via the unified gate.
reviewInput.name: Name
reviewInput.formDescription: Four-field definition (knowledge text / finding template / severity whitelist / version); there is no executable-code, HTTP or database-write surface.
reviewInput.outdatedNoteBody: Every save recomputes the immutable config_hash; a changed hash makes every unsubmitted review referencing the old hash outdated, while submitted orders keep their frozen snapshot.
reviewInput.deleteDescription: Delete {{name}}? Entries ever referenced by a review cannot be physically deleted — disable instead.
reviewInput.deleteErrorHint: The entry is referenced by a review or rule set and can only be disabled.
reviewInput.templateSeverityHint: The severity of the finding this definition produces; leave empty to rely on the whitelist semantics. The backend validates it against the whitelist only when set.

skills.title: Review skills (Prompt Tools)
skills.description: Skill registry: state, config hash and governance; binding happens on the flow editor, not here.
skills.emptyDescription: Register the first Prompt Tool to carry business review rules.
skills.builtinHint: System-owned skill: only the state can be toggled; definition edits and deletes are refused.
skills.builtinDialogBody: The name, engine and definition are system-owned and locked; this save can only toggle the state.
skills.evalGateHint: The Eval gate (structure/privacy/injection/severity) runs at save time: an enabled save validates inline — a failure blocks the save and shows the error in place.

knowledge.title: Internal experience (knowledge)
knowledge.description: The third review input: environment boundaries. Sources are limited to manual authoring and one-click finding conversion — no automatic learning.
knowledge.evalDescription: Pre-enable governance checks: structured output, privacy scan, injection check and severity validation.

providers.title: Provider management
providers.description: Primary/backup order follows selection_priority ascending; API keys are never echoed.
providers.formDescription: OpenAI Compatible endpoint and model; the privacy and output-schema hashes are verified by the runtime.
providers.name: Name
providers.priorityHint: 1-100; the lowest number is the primary provider.
providers.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Configured; leave empty to keep, type to replace
providers.emptyDescription: Create the first AI provider to enable the review runtime.
providers.deleteDescription: Delete provider {{name}}? The review runtime will no longer select it.
providers.deleteErrorHint: The provider is still referenced by the review runtime; disable it instead.

aiBudget.title: AI budget
aiBudget.description: Global daily AI cost budget and cost alert; resets daily at 00:00 system time — changing the budget never clears current-cycle usage.
aiBudget.r008Body: The system provides only a global daily AI cost budget and a provider cost alert; no per-order token or cost budget exists anywhere. Alerts go to the single admin only.
aiBudget.enforcedHint: Rejects new model calls once the budget is exhausted; takes effect immediately and saving requires two-step confirmation.
aiBudget.minorUnitsHint: Counted in minor currency units (e.g. cents); resets daily.
aiBudget.alertHint: Notifies the admin when usage reaches this percentage.
aiBudget.dirtyHint: Unsaved changes: assess impact before saving.
aiBudget.confirmHint: High-impact changes need two-step confirmation: confirming submits the single-use impact token with the save (valid for 300 seconds).
aiBudget.preconditionHint: The impact token expired, was consumed or the proposal changed — assess the impact again before saving.
aiBudget.revisionsDescription: Typed projection of successful updates for this namespace (retained 90 days); read-only, no rollback.

ruleSets.title: Rule sets
ruleSets.description: A rule set is a pure prompt-tool combination; review rules follow the change flow.
ruleSets.formDescription: Combine enabled skills; draft skills cannot be bound. Every save recomputes the config hash.
ruleSets.name: Name
ruleSets.impactHashNote: Changing the combination changes the config hash: unsubmitted reviews referencing the old hash become outdated; submitted orders are unaffected.
ruleSets.bindingChangeNote: The change will affect future prechecks of the flows above.
ruleSets.deleteBlockedHint: Still bound by flows: unbind on the flow editor first
ruleSets.deleteDescription: Delete rule set {{name}}? Bound rule sets cannot be deleted.
ruleSets.emptyDescription: Create the first rule set to combine review skills.

entry.title: Query
entry.description: Enter the online read-only query workspace through your granted query flows.
entry.failed: Failed to enter the query workspace
entry.needsAccessDescription: Query approval is enabled for {{name}}: submit a datasource access request first; an approved grant unlocks the workspace.
entry.emptyDescription: Once an administrator grants a query flow through a permission group, the entry appears here.
entry.grantsDescription: Approved access eligibility and its validity.
entry.flowsDescription: Granted query flows and their datasource capabilities.

apply.title: Request datasource access: {{name}}
apply.description: Approval covers datasource access eligibility, never SQL. The request carries no query statement.
apply.datasourcesHint: Multi-select from the flow's datasources (not all selected by default); datasources outside the flow cannot be added.

workspace.title: Query workspace · {{name}}
workspace.revokedGeneric: The grant backing this session has been revoked.
workspace.closedDescription: This query session was closed; re-enter from the query entry.
workspace.expiredDescription: The grant expired or the account was removed; request access again.
workspace.renewHint: Renewal starts a fresh full approval and creates a new grant; the original stays valid until it expires.
workspace.treeBlocked: The session is no longer usable; metadata browsing is blocked.
workspace.historyEmpty: SQL executed in this session appears here (in-session memory).
workspace.revokedSeeMine: Re-apply to continue querying; revocation records are under 我的工单 → 查询工单 (operator/time fields arrive once the read contract declares them).

run.singleSelectHint: Single SELECT only (server validation is authoritative)

result.empty: Results appear here after you run a query

export.title: Export query results
export.description: The browser reads cursor pages incrementally and builds the XLSX locally; the server persists no export files.
export.failedWithRange: Export failed ({{message}}). {{rows}} rows were read; no file was produced.

exit.title: Exit query session
exit.description: Exiting terminates this session and requests cancellation of running queries; re-entering resolves datasources from the current flow.

records.title: Audit records
records.description: Append-only 90-day audit events (S004); readable by the builtin admin only.
records.noScopeDescription: The audit read face is limited to the builtin admin; see 我的工单 for business records.
records.cardDescription: Cursor-paged, newest first; filter parameters are not yet declared on the contract (RCP-pending).

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Identity, security, appearance, notifications and display settings.

security.title: Account & security
security.passwordNote: No self-service password endpoint is declared: local passwords are managed by administrators; LDAP/OIDC accounts are managed by the identity source.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Notification channels are a server-side admin surface.
notifications.readOnlyNote: Channels are configured by administrators in system settings; no per-user options exist (read-only).

display.title: Display
display.description: Interface language; the statistics timezone is a system-level contract with no per-user override.

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.description: User management: create, edit and delete (full impact preview before deletion).
adminUsers.createDescription: Username, display name and initial password; no role management (P102).
adminUsers.cardDescription: No disabled state: users have deletion only (P105).
adminUsers.editDescription: Only display name and email are editable; username and password are not on this surface.

delete.title: Delete user: {{name}}
delete.description: The full impact is previewed first; business facts and frozen identities are preserved.
delete.snapshotsPreserved: Historical snapshots and business facts are preserved (P105).

adminGroups.title: Permission groups
adminGroups.description: Permission groups control which change and query flows members may enter (P101); never datasources.
adminGroups.formDescription: Members and flow grants; no reviewer/executor authorization entries.

preview.title: Per-user effective permissions
preview.description: Pick a user to see their enabled groups and the union of granted flows.
preview.placeholder: Enter a user id to preview
preview.noGroups: Not a member of any enabled group

adminGroups.cardDescription: The legacy datasource transfers (ddl/dml/query) are deleted (§3).

delete.title: Delete permission group: {{name}}
delete.description: Members lose this group's flow grants after deletion.

adminFlows.title: Flows
adminFlows.description: Flow management: change and query flows use separate form models.
adminFlows.cardDescription: Template edits never affect submitted orders (§3).

delete.title: Delete flow: {{name}}
delete.description: Flows referenced by permission groups cannot be deleted.

adminFlows.formDescription: Every step actor is a concrete user.
adminFlows.noRetroactiveNote: Edits never affect submitted orders: submitted orders keep their frozen flow snapshot.
adminFlows.schemaMappingsHint: Logical-to-physical schema mapping; may stay empty.
adminFlows.approvalStepsHint: 1..10 steps; within a step any approve passes and any reject rejects the whole item.
adminFlows.queryDatasourcesHint: Grant query and export capabilities per datasource.
adminFlows.maskingRulesHint: Literal column names per datasource (≤256 entries; case-fold normalized and deduplicated server-side).

adminAnnouncements.title: Announcements
adminAnnouncements.description: Home announcements: append-only revisions with a single publication pointer (S005).
adminAnnouncements.createDescription: Restricted Markdown input; the server produces sanitized HTML.
adminAnnouncements.revisionsDescription: Revisions cannot be edited or deleted (append-only).
adminAnnouncements.markdownHint: Headings, bold and inline code are supported; scripts, iframes and event attributes are sanitized away server-side.

adminIdp.title: Identity providers
adminIdp.description: LDAP singleton and OIDC list; secrets never echo back (configured presence only).
adminIdp.ldapDescription: Exactly one LDAP provider; transport is ldaps/starttls only — no plaintext and no skip-verify option.
adminIdp.oidcDescription: The callback address is server-generated and not configured here.
adminIdp.formDescription: Secrets never prefill: leave empty to keep.

field.callbackNote: The OIDC callback address is generated by the server.
field.secretEditHint: Leave empty to keep; clearing requires a disabled provider.

adminIdp.formSecretRequired: A secret is required on create

delete.title: Delete provider: {{key}}
delete.description: Only disabled providers can be deleted.

adminNotifications.title: Notifications
adminNotifications.description: Email and DingTalk channels; Outbox-driven with at most five retries (S003).
adminNotifications.channelsDescription: Channel changes apply immediately; test deliveries go through the same Outbox loop.
adminNotifications.deliveriesDescription: Outbox state machine: queued→sending→succeeded/failed; dead-letter after at most 5 attempts.
adminNotifications.secretRequired: A secret is required on create

delete.title: Delete channel: {{name}}
delete.description: New events stop flowing through the channel; delivery history is preserved.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Registration switch, system timezone and default locale.

query.title: Query settings
query.description: Query approval switch, default timeout and the grant duration ceiling.
query.approvalHint: Disabled: access resolves directly from granted flows; enabled: access requests must be approved.
query.noLimitNote: The system offers no total-row, total-byte, user-concurrency, export-row or file-size limits (Q005).

execution.title: Execution settings
execution.description: Execution window restriction and OSC policy.
